report.summary: An error rate surge on payments-api and mobile-bff started at 2026-10-02T14:03:00+00:00, exactly one minute after a deployment of payments-api v2.14.0 (chg-9890) which refactored payment-intent validation and bumped the JSON library. The deployment caused a NullPointerException in PaymentIntentValidator.java:88 due to payer_vpa being null, leading to 500 errors on payment attempts.

supporting.note: Deploy of v2.14.0 at 14:02 UTC immediately preceded the onset of errors at 14:03 UTC.
Payments-api error rate surged starting at 14:03 UTC.
Mobile-bff error rate surged starting at 14:03 UTC.
Mobile-bff logged upstream errors indicating payments-api responded with 500 starting at 14:03 UTC.
Payments-api logged NullPointerException at PaymentIntentValidator.java:88 regarding payer_vpa being null starting at 14:03 UTC.

contradicting.note: Logs explicitly attribute the NullPointerException to payments-api internal validator code (PaymentIntentValidator.java:88), and no mobile-bff deployment occurred around that time.

facts.text: mobile-bff error rate started increasing at 2026-10-02T14:03:00Z, reaching a peak of 6.29% at 14:09:00Z.
payments-api error rate started increasing at 2026-10-02T14:03:00Z, reaching a peak of 20.29% at 14:07:00Z.
payments-api CPU usage increased starting at 2026-10-02T14:03:00Z, peaking at 48.63% at 14:19:00Z.
mobile-bff logged upstream errors indicating payments-api responded with 500 for POST /v1/payments/intent starting at 2026-10-02T14:03:01Z.
payments-api logged NullPointerException at PaymentIntentValidator.java:88 where payer_vpa is null, starting at 2026-10-02T14:03:05Z.
A deploy for payments-api (v2.14.0, refactor payment-intent validation, bump json library) occurred at 2026-10-02T14:02:00+00:00 (chg-9890).

assumptions: The refactored payment-intent validation logic in v2.14.0 incorrectly handles or strips the deserialization of payer_vpa under certain request payloads or json library behaviors.

timeline.event: Mobile-bff and payments-api error rate metrics begin to surge.
Mobile-bff logs upstream 500 errors from payments-api for POST /v1/payments/intent.
Payments-api logs NullPointerException at PaymentIntentValidator.java:88 due to null payer_vpa.

recommended_actions.action: Rollback payments-api deployment v2.14.0 to the previous stable version (v2.13.4).
recommended_actions.rationale: Directly mitigates the active bad deploy causing 500 errors and transaction failures.

recommended_actions.action: Fix the null check for payer_vpa inside PaymentIntentValidator.java and audit JSON library deserialization behavior.
recommended_actions.rationale: Resolves the root cause of the NullPointerException introduced in the v2.14.0 refactor.

recommended_actions.action: Add automated integration tests covering validation behaviors with unpopulated or optional payment intent fields like payer_vpa.
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents similar deserialization or null-reference regressions during future validator refactors.
